story: 部門一覧から化学専門科目を開き、原問画像を読み、解答・全肢理由を確認し、保存後の再読み込みで復元する。

screenshots.reason: Playwright connector rejected save to the dedicated worktree; its allowed roots point to the original tree. Did not retry screenshot save through another path or client.

toolArtifactLocationNote: The connected browser tool automatically stored snapshots/traces under the original workspace .playwright-mcp before its save-root constraint was discovered. No source files there were edited; those tool-owned traces were left untouched.
